head: daccc569
headSubject: feat(SEC-3): fungible worker pool for plugin IPC (Model B step 3)
summary: Implemented and shipped SEC-3 Model B step 2 (real ProcessBuilder child process, replacing step 1's piped streams) and step 3 (fixed-size pool of fungible worker processes with invocation-ceiling/idle-timeout recycling and background-thread crash replacement), each fully verified via a green full run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 and pushed. Along the way, traced all 4 RuntimePluginArtifactRealizationProvider strategies and found they all resolve real plugin classes through a Spring-bean runtimeRef lookup with no queryable adapter-to-FQCN manifest -- meaning the pool is proven against real, compiled TEST handler classes only, not this platform's actual generated plugins yet; recorded as a tracked follow-up in ledger/items/SEC-3.yml rather than attempted inline. Fixed two real bugs found via narrow --tests reruns during step 2 (a Windows CreateProcess classpath-length limit, a test-assertion off-by-one) and two more during step 3 (a non-effectively-final lambda capture, an existing test broken by InvokeFrame's new field). SEC-3 remains OPEN -- memory/CPU is still unbounded until step 4, and no real shipped plugin runs through Model B yet.
nextStep: Two independent forks remain, neither depending on the other -- ask the user which to tackle before starting, since guessing wrong on either wastes real work: (a) SEC-3 step 4 per docs/architecture/PLUGIN_PROCESS_ISOLATION_DESIGN.md section 3 -- per-OS resource limits (Linux cgroups v2 via systemd-run --scope; Windows Job Objects via a new JNA/JNI binding, called out in the design doc as genuinely new dependency surface) -- this is the step that actually closes SEC-3's memory/CPU done-when bar; or (b) the real-plugin-classloading gap found this session -- add a new NPDevGenerator-side manifest (RuntimeApiEmitter, adapter/capability/operation -> FQCN + operation-method map, alongside the existing unkeyed plugin-owned-classes.txt) so PluginIpcChildProcessPool can run actual generated plugins instead of only the test handler classes steps 1-3 have used -- this is a NPDevGenerator change with its own generator-determinism and twin-pair-consistency implications per CLAUDE.md.
verified: Local: two full run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 runs green this session (assembled sample app's own gradle test task BUILD SUCCESSFUL both times across 665+ tests including all new PluginIpcChildProcessTest and PluginIpcChildProcessPoolTest cases, runtimehost-core's own gradle test task BUILD SUCCESSFUL, coverage-floor + runtime-surface-evidence checks passed both times). No CI run confirmed this session -- commits pushed but CI status not checked.
